```python
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == 1]
    # Continue the southeast diagonal from the furthest existing diagonal 1.
    r, c = max(ones, key=lambda p: p[0] + p[1])
    while r + 1 < h and c + 1 < w:
        r += 1
        c += 1
        out[r][c] = 1
    return out
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row),
             key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))

    visited = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                if not (0 <= r + dr < h and 0 <= c + dc < w
                        and grid[r + dr][c + dc] == color):
                    continue

                # Get the full contiguous diagonal segment.
                sr, sc = r, c
                while (0 <= sr-dr < h and 0 <= sc-dc < w
                       and grid[sr-dr][sc-dc] == color):
                    sr, sc = sr-dr, sc-dc
                er, ec = r, c
                while (0 <= er+dr < h and 0 <= ec+dc < w
                       and grid[er+dr][ec+dc] == color):
                    er, ec = er+dr, ec+dc
                key = (sr, sc, er, ec, color)
                if key in visited:
                    continue
                visited.add(key)

                for rr, cc, step_r, step_c in (
                    (sr-dr, sc-dc, -dr, -dc),
                    (er+dr, ec+dc, dr, dc),
                ):
                    # A neighboring non-background marker blocks extension
                    # from that end of the diagonal.
                    if any(0 <= rr2 < h and 0 <= cc2 < w and grid[rr2][cc2] != bg
                           for rr2, cc2 in ((sr, sc-1), (sr, sc+1), (sr-1, sc), (sr+1, sc))
                           if (rr, cc) == (sr-dr, sc-dc)) or \
                       any(0 <= rr2 < h and 0 <= cc2 < w and grid[rr2][cc2] != bg
                           for rr2, cc2 in ((er, ec-1), (er, ec+1), (er-1, ec), (er+1, ec))
                           if (rr, cc) == (er+dr, ec+dc)):
                        continue

                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == bg:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += step_r
                        cc += step_c
    return out
```
